assessments.summary: The audited artifacts establish that `coloring.csv` assigns exactly one of six colors to every integer from 1 through 536 and contains no monochromatic solution to x+y=z, including x=y. The verifier exhaustively checks all 71,824 relevant ordered representatives with 1≤x≤y and x+y≤536. This proves S(6)≥536.
scopeQualifications: The certificate provides no coloring beyond 536 and therefore does not improve the lower bound.
It contains no upper-bound argument; the supplied published interval remains 536≤S(6)≤1836.
